entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A human former planeswalker from Tarkir obsessed with dragons, who served Bolas, saved Ugin in the past, and lost his spark after the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who manipulated Sarkhan, killed Ugin on Tarkir, and was defeated in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, Tarkir's soul, whom Bolas killed in the past and whom Sarkhan preserved with a hedron.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Sarkhan's war-scourged home plane, whose history was rewritten by Ugin's survival.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: The Jeskai khan who calmed Sarkhan, died to Zurgo in one timeline, and lived in the new one; later desparked.

entities.name: Zurgo Helmsmasher
entities.description: A Mardu warlord who killed Narset in the original timeline.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: A Temur shaman in Tarkir's past who unknowingly served Bolas by marking the path to Ugin.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker attacked by Sarkhan in the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath planeswalker who helped Chandra defeat Sarkhan.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The Zendikar site of the Eldrazi confinement, where Sarkhan took a hedron fragment.

entities.name: Hedron fragment
entities.description: A shard of a floating hedron taken from the Eye of Ugin that Sarkhan used to save Ugin.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: An archangel planeswalker who defeated Sarkhan at the Nexus.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A Jeskai monk who taught Sarkhan the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A ritual used to regain draconic power, and by Narset and clan leaders to create Spirit Dragons.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who witnessed Sarkhan's transformation and warned the Abzan court.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A Jund warrior in Bolas's service who led Sarkhan to him.

entities.name: Malactoth
entities.description: A hellkite killed by Kresh and Rakka Mar with Sarkhan's help.

entities.name: Karrthus
entities.description: A dragon later brainwashed by Bolas.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer whose trail Sarkhan followed for Bolas.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire ruin sage who attacked Chandra in the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A fellow planeswalker whose broken body Bolas showed Sarkhan.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A Ravnican dragon resurrected with Sarkhan's help.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who gave her spear against Bolas.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who led a group to disable Bolas's Planar Bridge on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Bolas's realm, taken back by Ugin with Sarkhan's help.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle on Ravnica in which Bolas was defeated.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Tarkir after which Sarkhan lost his spark.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: An Abzan khan who fought Sarkhan's dragons.

events.summary: As a Mardu general, Sarkhan is touched by an ancient dragon spirit, sacrifices his men in a massive spell and ascends as a planeswalker.
events.quote: Sacrificing his men, he unleashed a massive spell that wiped the battlefield clean as he ascended

events.summary: On Alara, Sarkhan swears allegiance to Bolas and exchanges blood with him.
events.quote: Upon that spot, Sarkhan swore his allegiance to Bolas and exchanged blood with the dragon

events.summary: Sarkhan's mind unravels after he sees Bolas absorb the Maelstrom and be defeated by a duplicate avatar.
events.quote: Seeing his master defeated caused something within Sarkhan to snap, and his mind started to unravel.

events.summary: Sarkhan wanders the Eye of Ugin on Bolas's orders and saves Chandra from Anowon.
events.quote: he became lucid in time to save Chandra Nalaar from an attack by the vampire ruin sage named Anowon

events.summary: Sarkhan attacks Chandra as a dragon; Jace and Chandra defeat him with Ugin's invisible fire, unlocking the Eldrazi confinement.
events.quote: But this action unwittingly opened the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell.

events.summary: Sarkhan takes a hedron chunk to Bolas's Meditation Realm, where Bolas reveals he meant to free the Eldrazi all along.
events.quote: Bolas reveals he intended to free the Eldrazi all along

events.summary: Sarkhan returns to Tarkir; Narset calms his mind and he tells her about planeswalkers and Bolas.
events.quote: Narset's gentle nature helped Sarkhan to focus his mind temporarily.

events.summary: Zurgo kills Narset at Ugin's Tomb and Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate.
events.quote: which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

events.summary: Sarkhan arrives in Tarkir's past and sees dragons emerge from a storm.
events.quote: Sarkhan realized that he had arrived in Tarkir's past.

events.summary: Sarkhan meets Yasova Dragonclaw, who is guided by the voice of a golden dragon.
events.quote: The woman introduced herself as Yasova Dragonclaw

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes Yasova's voice is Bolas and that he is coming to kill Ugin.
events.quote: The horns of Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Bolas fights Ugin; Yasova's spell grips Sarkhan and Ugin is mortally wounded.
events.quote: Bolas struck against Ugin, who fended the Elder Dragon off

events.summary: Sarkhan activates the hedron around the dying Ugin, preserving him and rewriting history.
events.quote: history had been reforged, and Sarkhan's life became an impossibility

events.summary: Sarkhan returns to a new Tarkir ruled by dragons and learns he can use blue mana.
events.quote: Dragons now ruled the plane thanks to the actions taken in the past

events.summary: Sarkhan explains the old timeline to Ugin and Narset and plans to explore the new Tarkir with her.
events.quote: He then decides to accompany her to meet Ugin as they plan to explore the new Tarkir together.

events.summary: Sarkhan helps Ugin bypass Bolas's wards and retrieves Niv's ghost box for the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: He delivered the " ghost box" to the Meditation Realm

events.summary: Sarkhan helps Hazoret restore the Hekma and she gives a spear to Karn's group against Bolas.
events.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear to aid them in their fight against Bolas

events.summary: Sarkhan fights in the War of the Spark and sees his vengeance when Bolas is defeated.
events.quote: he also attained the vengeance he desired

events.summary: After the Phyrexian invasion of Tarkir, Sarkhan loses his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: In the aftermath of the invasion, Sarkhan lost his planeswalker spark .

events.summary: Narset and clan leaders perform the Stormnexus Ritual, giving rise to Spirit Dragons that defeat the dragonlords.
events.quote: the dragonlords were driven into the tempests and disappeared

events.summary: Sarkhan attacks Elspeth at the Nexus but is easily defeated.
events.quote: He attacked her but was easily defeated.

events.summary: Taigam has Sarkhan kill a dragon and eat its heart; Sarkhan becomes a massive corrupted dragon commanding a dragon army.
events.quote: Sarkhan killed a wild dragon and bit into its heart, transforming himself into a massive, corrupted dragon

events.summary: Ugin emerges and burns Sarkhan's dragon form with ghostfire, sending him plummeting.
events.quote: He responded with a torrent of ghostfire , which rapidly charred Sarkhan's dragon form, sending him plummeting out of the storm.

relations.note: Swore allegiance, later turned against him.
relations.quote: Sarkhan swore his allegiance to Bolas

relations.note: Killed him on Tarkir in the past.
relations.quote: Nicol Bolas, who had killed Ugin over a thousand years ago
spy on his brother without any chance of being noticed
Sarkhan conspired with Ugin to defeat the elder dragon

relations.note: Formed a bond of respect and friendship.
relations.quote: they formed a bond of respect and friendship

relations.note: Killed her at Ugin's Tomb in the original timeline.
relations.quote: which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

relations.note: Followed the voice in her visions.
relations.quote: the voice in her visions bid her track the dragon storms and leave a trail to the Spirit Dragon's lair
The spell Taigam had taught Sarkhan was the Stormnexus Ritual

relations.note: Opposed her attempt to prevent the return of dragons.
relations.quote: Sarkhan expressed his desire for the return of the dragons, which Elspeth was trying to prevent.
Sarkhan Vol is a human former planeswalker hailing from Tarkir
